vo_scene_1.text: Every month, global import-export SMEs lose thousands of dollars to correspondent banking friction, paying up to 3.5% in hidden FX spreads and waiting 3 to 5 business days for simple cross-border wires. FlowAgent OS transforms this broken accounts payable workflow into an autonomous, non-custodial settlement engine.

vo_scene_2.text: When commercial invoices arrive—via PDF, OCR, or ERP webhooks—our semantic layer extracts structured invoice schemas instantly, syncing directly with our U-Bot Copilot to prepare executive sign-off.

vo_scene_3.text: Before any fund movement occurs, the deterministic routing core benchmarks the real cost: traditional banking drains 112 dollars and 50 cents with three intermediary banks. FlowAgent routes over Avalanche C-Chain for just 2 dollars and 50 cents, capturing 98% in fee savings.

vo_scene_4.text: With one executive click, the non-custodial signer broadcasts directly to Avalanche Snowman BFT consensus. Irrevocable finality is achieved in milliseconds with full cryptographic verification and instant 1-click CSV reconciliation for local accounting suites like PEAK and FlowAccount.

vo_scene_5.text: Financial operations demand zero tolerance for AI hallucinations. When an invoice targets an OFAC-sanctioned wallet, our Deterministic Compliance Guard terminates execution in under 35 milliseconds—guaranteeing zero funds move and zero gas is lost.

vo_scene_6.text: AI at the interface. Deterministic code at the core. FlowAgent OS: institutional cross-border finance at the speed of consensus.
